content:
Marta L: Flagging a cluster of UX + a11y nits from the alerting preview review. main concerns: order semantics, suppressed vs muted language, and historical preview mode. Diego F: Saw the ticket. users are confused because preview shows "last updated" order not priority or runtime dispatch. need to pick one canonical display. Nora P: Accessibility: whatever we pick, DOM order must match visual order. CSS reordering causes NVDA/VoiceOver to read things out of sync. Sam K: Engineering note: runtime dispatch can insert fallbacks (eg smsfallback) after failures, so dispatch != user-configured priority. we should avoid claiming the preview is "priority" if it's not. Marta L: Proposal: two display modes in header dropdown: "Dispatch (runtime)" and "Configured priority." default to Dispatch but label it clearly with a short explainer. Diego F: +1. Also, show suppressed channels rather than hiding them. render them in a muted row with an explicit label: "Suppressed until 16:12 (rule: weekend-quiet)". include the actor if available. Nora P: For screenreaders: add an aria-live summary that reads a count and the ordered list. e.g., "This alert will notify 2 channels: PagerDuty, then Slack. Suppressed: Ops-email until 2h 13m." Keep polite tone. Sam K: API ask: include a preview_snapshot array with items {id, name, state, suppressed_until_iso, suppressed_until_relative, actor}. frontend can then render without client-side sorting. Marta L: Copy note: "suppressed" vs "muted" is causing mistakes. support reported users disabling channels thinking alerts were turned off. we should change labels to be clearer: "Suppressed (policy)" and "Muted (you)" with hover details. Diego F: Visual grouping might help: group headings "Sending now", "Suppressed (policy)", "Muted (you)". be mindful that headings get announced by SRs; use semantic grouping (role="group" + aria-label). Nora P: Also recommend announcing group counts: "2 sending, 1 suppressed, 1 muted" at the top. users often want the quick summary. Sam K: Keyboard behavior: focus should land on the summary aria-live when opening the preview. arrow keys to navigate channels; Enter to expand suppression/mute details. ensure Enter target is reachable and labelled. Marta L: Mobile: collapse into one-line summary with an expand chevron. expand control needs aria-expanded and a clear visible focus ring. suppressed entries should show a tiny badge when collapsed like "+1 suppressed". Diego F: Timeline mode request: some customers want "View as of" so they can simulate how the alert would have routed at the trigger time. implement as a simple dropdown: Now / At trigger / Custom (date). show a small disclaimer when in historical mode. Nora P: For SR-friendly phrasing use relative times: "suppressed for 2h 5m" rather than raw ISO. still include iso in data for machines. Sam K: Small aria snippet for reuse: ```
This alert will notify 2 channels: PagerDuty, then Slack. Suppressed: Ops-email for 2h 5m.
``` Marta L: Tooltip copy idea for "Why this order?": "Displays runtime dispatch order. To view configured priority choose 'Configured' from the dropdown." One-liner. Diego F: Rollout: put behind console feature-flag. infra needs a short migration plan if we add preview_snapshot to the API. include fallback for older CLIs. inc-bot: Reminder: file a follow-up issue in UX backlog: https://go/redwood/ux/issues/5241 - "alert preview: dispatch vs priority + suppression clarity" Nora P: I'll add accessibility test cases (NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack) and include keyboard scenarios + screenreader transcripts. Marta L: I'll mock two variants (compact grouped, and timeline mode) and post images. tagging @Nora P and @Sam K for quick sign-off when done. :thumbsup:
